exhaustion_with_idle_action_wait_survives_sleep() {\n    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};\n\n    /// Mock store that returns NoWork initially, then a bead after N calls.\n    struct DelayedBeadStore {\n        call_count: AtomicU32,\n        bead_after: u32,\n        bead: Mutex<Option<Bead>>,\n        /// Tracks claimed beads (moved here from `bead` on claim).\n        claimed: DelayedBeadStore {\n        async fn ready(&self, _filters: &Filters) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {\n            // After the bead is released, signal the worker to exit by returning an error.\n            if self.bead_released.load(Ordering::SeqCst) == 1 {\n                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\"test complete - bead was released\"));\n            }\n            let count = self.call_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n            if count >= self.bead_after {\n                // Return the bead if it's available (not yet claimed or claimed but not yet released).\n                let bead = self.bead.lock().unwrap();\n                let claimed = self.claimed.lock().unwrap();\n                if bead.is_some() && !claimed.iter().any(|b| b.id == bead.as_ref().unwrap().id) {\n                    Ok(vec![bead.clone().unwrap()])\n                } else {\n                    Ok(vec![])\n                }\n            } else {\n                Ok(Vec::new())\n            }\n        }\n\n        async fn list_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<Bead>> {\n            let bead = self.bead.lock().unwrap();\n            let claimed = self.claimed.lock().unwrap();\n            let mut all: Vec<Bead> = claimed.clone();\n            if let Some(b) = bead.as_ref() {\n                if !all.iter().any(|x| x.id == b.id) {\n                    all.push(b.clone());\n                }\n            }\n            Ok(all)\n        }\n\n        async fn show(&self, id: &BeadId) -> Result<Bead> {\n            let claimed = self.claimed.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(b) = claimed.iter().find(|b| b.id == *id) {\n                return Ok(b.clone());\n            }\n            let bead = self.bead.lock().unwrap();\n            match bead.as_ref() {\n                Some(b) if b.id == *id => Ok(b.clone()),\n                _ => anyhow::bail!(\"bead not found: {id}\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        async fn claim(&self, id: &BeadId, actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n            let bead = self.bead.lock().unwrap();\n            let mut claimed = BeadStatus::InProgress;\n                    cloned.assignee = Some(actor.to_string());\n                    claimed.push(cloned.clone());\n                    Ok(ClaimResult::Claimed(cloned))\n                }\n                _ => Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {\n                    reason: \"no bead\".to_string(),\n                }),\n            }\n        }\n\n        async fn claim_auto(&self, _actor: &str) -> Result<ClaimResult> {\n            Ok(ClaimResult::NotClaimable {\n                reason: \"no beads available\".to_string(),\n            })\n        }\n\n Ok(())\n        }\n\n        async fn block(&self, _id: &BeadId) -> Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n\n        async fn flush(&self) -> Result<()> {\n            Ok(())\n        }\n\n ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n#[test]\nfn outcome_classify_covers_all_exit_code_ranges() {\n    // Verify that classify handles the full i32 range without panicking.\n    // This is a smoke test to ensure no gaps exist.\n    let test_codes: Vec<i32> = vec![\n        i32::MIN,\n        -1000,\n        -1,\n        0,\n        1,\n        2,\n        50,\n        99,\n        100,\n        123,\n        124,\n        125,\n        126,\n        127,\n        128,\n        129,\n        130,\n        137,\n        143,\n        255,\n        256,\n        1000,\n        i32::MAX,\n    ];\n\n    for code in test_codes {\n        // Should not panic.\n        let outcome = Outcome::classify(code, false);\n        // Verify specific mappings.\n        match code {\n            0 => assert_eq!(outcome, Outcome::Success),\n            1 => assert_eq!(outcome, Outcome::Failure),\n            124 => assert_eq!(outcome, Outcome::Timeout),\n            127 => assert_eq!(outcome, Outcome::AgentNotFound),\n            c if c > 128 => assert_eq!(outcome, Outcome::Crash(c)),\n            c if c < 0 => assert_eq!(outcome, Outcome::Crash(c)),\n            _ => {} // Other codes just shouldn't panic\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Verify interrupted flag always wins.\n    for code in [-1, 0, 1, 127, 137] {\n        assert_eq!(\n            Outcome::classify(code, true),\n            Outcome::Interrupted,\n            \"was_interrupted=true must always return Interrupted for code {code}\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n// Test 7: Worker config validation at boot\n// Without proper isolation, tests can:\n\n- Create phantom beads in real repositories\n- Contaminate production bead stores\n- Scan and modify real user workspaces\n- Leave orphaned state files\n\n## The Three Pillars of Isolation\n\n### 1. HOME Directory Isolation (Required)\n\nAll tests that spawn the `needle` binary MUST isolate the HOME directory. The Explore strand (enabled by default) scans `workspace_root` (defaulting to `$HOME`) for bead workspaces.\n\n**Pattern: Set HOME in test environment**\n\n```rust\nlet temp_home = TempHome::new()?;\ncmd.env(\"HOME\", temp_home.path());\n```\n\n**Why this matters:**\n- The Explore strand auto-discovers workspaces under HOME\n- Without isolation, test processes see real repos\n- Phantom beads get created under test worker IDs\n- Recovery requires manual bead cleanup or database repair\n\n### 2. Workspace/Tempdir Cleanup\n\nAll test-created directories MUST be cleaned up, even on panic. Use fixtures that implement Drop for automatic cleanup.\n\n**Pattern: RAII fixtures**\n\n```rust\nlet temp_home = TempHome::new()?; // Auto-cleanup on drop\nlet workspace = temp_home.create_workspace(\"test-ws\")?;\n```\n\n**Implementation:**\n- Use `tempfile::TempDir` for temporary directories\n- Implement Drop for custom fixtures\n- Never rely on test completion for cleanup\n\n### 3. Process Guarding\n\nLong-running subprocesses MUST be wrapped in guards that ensure cleanup.\n\n**Pattern: ProcessGuard**\n\n```rust\nlet child = Command::new(\"needle\").spawn()?;\nlet mut guard = ProcessGuard::new(child);\n// Guard kills and waits on drop, preventing zombies\n```\n\n**Why this matters:**\n- Tests may panic before explicit cleanup\n- Zombies accumulate and consume system resources\n- Guards ensure cleanup in all code paths\n\n## Available Infrastructure\n\n### Fixtures in `tests/adapter_validation_tests.rs`\n\n- **`TempHome`**: Isolated HOME directory fixture\n  - Creates standard subdirectories (`.cache`, `.config`)\n  - Auto-cleanup on drop\n  - Methods for creating workspaces and configs\n\n- **`TempWorkspace`**: Temporary workspace fixture\n  - Creates directory structure\n  - Initializes git repository\n  - Creates bead store configuration\n\n- **`TempFile`**: Temporary file fixture\n  - Creates files with custom content\n  - Auto-cleanup on drop\n  - Useful for test prompts and configs\n\n### Process Management in `tests/process_guard.rs`\n\n- **`ProcessGuard`**: Child process cleanup guard\n  - Automatic kill and wait on drop\n  - Explicit control methods\n  - Prevents zombie processes\n\n### Workspace Management in `tests/workspace_fixtures.rs`\n\n- **Mock workspace structures**: For testing workspace discovery\n- **Scenario builders**: For creating complex test scenarios\n- **Mock bead stores**: For testing bead store interactions\n\n## When to Use Each Pattern\n\n| Test Type | HOME Isolation | Workspace Cleanup | Process Guard |","numLines":100,"startLine":1,"totalLines":218}}}
